description:
If an insurant could be possibly subrogated against, I get information about that. 
I check that case and if the possibility is really there, I send a request for payment to the insurant and make me a reminder. 
If recourse is not possible, I close the case. 
When we receive the money, I make a booking and close the case. 
If the insurant disagrees with the recourse, I'll have to check the reasoning of that. 
If he is right, I simply close the case. 
If he is wrong, I forward the case to a collection agency. It the deadline for disagreement is reached and we haven't received any money, I forward the case to the collection agency as well.

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_Recourse"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/recourse">
  <bpmn:message id="Message_PaymentRequest" name="Payment request"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Payment" name="Payment"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_Disagreement" name="Disagreement"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Message_ForwardedCase" name="Forwarded case"/>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Recourse" name="Handle possible subrogation" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Information" name="Information about possible subrogation received">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start_CheckCase</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckCase" name="Check the case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start_CheckCase</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckCase_RecourseGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_RecoursePossible" name="Is recourse possible?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckCase_RecourseGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecourseNo_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_RecourseYes_Request</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_SendPaymentRequest" name="Send payment request to the insurant" messageRef="Message_PaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecourseYes_Request</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeReminder" name="Make a reminder">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Request_Reminder</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Reminder_WaitGateway</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:eventBasedGateway id="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" name="Wait for payment, disagreement, or disagreement deadline" eventGatewayType="Exclusive">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Reminder_WaitGateway</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:eventBasedGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_PaymentReceived" name="Payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Payment</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Payment_Booking</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Payment" messageRef="Message_Payment"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_MakeBooking" name="Make a booking">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Payment_Booking</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Booking_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementReceived" name="Insurant disagrees with recourse">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Disagreement</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MessageEventDefinition_Disagreement" messageRef="Message_Disagreement"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CheckReasoning" name="Check the reasoning">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CheckReasoning_InsurantRight</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_InsurantRight" name="Is the insurant right?">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CheckReasoning_InsurantRight</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantRight_CloseMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InsurantWrong_ForwardMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_DisagreementDeadline" name="Disagreement deadline reached with no payment received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Wait_Deadline</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Deadline_ForwardMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:timerEventDefinition id="TimerEventDefinition_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_CloseMerge" name="Merge case-closing paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_RecourseNo_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Booking_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantRight_CloseMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseMerge_CloseCase</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_CloseCase" name="Close the case">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseMerge_CloseCase</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CloseCase_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_ForwardMerge" name="Merge collection referral paths">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InsurantWrong_ForwardMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Deadline_ForwardMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForwardMerge_ForwardCase</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="Task_ForwardToAgency" name="Forward the case to the collection agency" messageRef="Message_ForwardedCase">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForwardMerge_ForwardCase</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ForwardCase_End</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseClosed" name="Case closed">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CloseCase_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CaseForwarded" name="Case forwarded to collection agency">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ForwardCase_End</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CheckCase" sourceRef="StartEvent_Information" targetRef="Task_CheckCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckCase_RecourseGateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckCase" targetRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecourseNo_CloseMerge" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Gateway_CloseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recourse is not possible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RecourseYes_Request" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_RecoursePossible" targetRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">recourse is possible</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Reminder" sourceRef="Task_SendPaymentRequest" targetRef="Task_MakeReminder"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Reminder_WaitGateway" sourceRef="Task_MakeReminder" targetRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Payment" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_PaymentReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Disagreement" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Deadline" sourceRef="Gateway_WaitForOutcome" targetRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Booking" sourceRef="Event_PaymentReceived" targetRef="Task_MakeBooking"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Booking_CloseMerge" sourceRef="Task_MakeBooking" targetRef="Gateway_CloseMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Disagreement_CheckReasoning" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementReceived" targetRef="Task_CheckReasoning"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckReasoning_InsurantRight" sourceRef="Task_CheckReasoning" targetRef="Gateway_InsurantRight"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantRight_CloseMerge" name="Yes" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="Gateway_CloseMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">the insurant is right</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InsurantWrong_ForwardMerge" name="No" sourceRef="Gateway_InsurantRight" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">the insurant is wrong</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Deadline_ForwardMerge" sourceRef="Event_DisagreementDeadline" targetRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseMerge_CloseCase" sourceRef="Gateway_CloseMerge" targetRef="Task_CloseCase"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CloseCase_End" sourceRef="Task_CloseCase" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseClosed"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardMerge_ForwardCase" sourceRef="Gateway_ForwardMerge" targetRef="Task_ForwardToAgency"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ForwardCase_End" sourceRef="Task_ForwardToAgency" targetRef="EndEvent_CaseForwarded"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
